required: highest active frequency is guaranteed or sharing is refused
leases retain the decoder until every consumer releases it
different source keys do not share a decoder

hypothesis: Um decoder compartilhado so e apropriado quando sua frequencia efetiva atende ao maior requisito ativo, ou quando o hub recusa o compartilhamento.
outcome: The initial deterministic run exposed a first-requester frequency bug. CameraHub now upgrades its backing decoder while preserving consumer handles; the follow-up deterministic run satisfies low-then-high, high-then-low, release, and different-key contracts.
scenarios: consumer at 5 frames/s then consumer at 12 frames/s on the same key
consumer at 12 frames/s then consumer at 5 frames/s on the same key
release both consumers in both-order safety condition
different keys do not share a decoder

scope.implementation: CameraHub production class with deterministic fake grabber

evidence.remaining_live_check: The runtime API does not expose a controlled target-FPS override, so the exact low-then-high transition is covered by the production-class deterministic reader rather than an extra live RTSP connection.

title: Contrato de compartilhamento do decoder e frequencia requerida
